description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing Capabilities data in a Room database for the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

classes.name: CapabilitiesDao
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for Capabilities entity, including insert and retrieval.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a Capabilities object into the database, replacing existing entries on conflict.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the Capabilities object with id 1 from the database.
